questions.question: What famous statement about love appears in chapter 8?
options: Many waters cannot quench the longing of the heart
Love is patient and kind, bearing all things in quiet hope
Love is strong as death; jealousy is fierce as the grave
Love covers a multitude of faults and never fails
questions.answer: Love is strong as death; jealousy is fierce as the grave

questions.question: What does chapter 8 say many waters cannot do?
options: Quench love, neither can floods drown it
Refresh love, nor can rivers renew it
Reach love, nor can the sea touch it
Bless love, nor can springs sustain it
questions.answer: Quench love, neither can floods drown it

questions.question: Chapter 8 says, 'Set me as a seal upon your heart.'
Set me as a seal upon your heart... for love is strong as _____.
Mighty waters cannot quench love; rivers cannot _____ it away.
